title: 1.0 editor runtimes loaded into the 1.1 page
summary: 1.0 code the editor page still loads before v3.js: the skill runtime, the IO skills, luqu, the microtune runtime, the plugin surfaces runtime, and the Quanta core and editor scripts. Each defines a global the page calls; none is a Luc.

carrier.notes: Script tags in static/v3/index.html, in a fixed order, all deferred.

replaceability.why: They run as the editor page with its full reach; a replacement would be code in the page shell. They are to be retired or turned into Lucs, not swapped.
replaceability.decided: self-Luc spec v0.3 foundation (the editor page shell); docs/luc/self-luc-inventory.md:101

operations.name: load
operations.notes: The globals each script defines and the calls v3.js makes into them are not written down here; draft.

invariants.text: The 1.0 runtimes load after the locale, settings and auth scripts and before luc-ui.js, luc-panel-host.js and v3.js.
